title: 地理与交通词汇
goal: 辨认地理与交通词汇，准确表达位置与连接关系。

points.label: 选择准确表达位置与连接关系的词语

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 地理与交通说明涉及地形、位置和路线。位于某地用 be located in；流经某地用 flow through，主语通常是河流。

body.box:
这条河流经山谷，公路连接山谷和城镇。
The river flows through the valley, and the road connects the valley with the town.

body.p: flow through 说明河流经过的区域。connect 说明两地相连，不指出去向。

cards.title: 词汇表：区域联系
rows: link the port with the city

body.box:
小镇位于山谷东部，一条河流经镇旁。桥梁横跨河流，公路由桥通往车站。桥梁连接两岸，但河水沿山谷向南流动。车站位于公路尽头，旅客可以从这里乘火车离开山谷。
The town is located in the eastern part of the valley, beside a river that flows past it. A bridge crosses the river, and a road leads from the bridge to the station. The bridge connects the banks, while the water flows south along the valley. The station stands at the end of the road, where travelers can take a train out of the valley.

body.p: located in 表示位置，flows past 表示流经镇旁。leads from ... to 标明道路的起点和终点。

body.box:
What connects the banks?
1. The road to the station
2. The bridge across the river
3. The river along the valley
4. The station beside the road

body.p: 第二项对应 The bridge connects the banks。河流沿山谷流动，桥梁横跨河流。

groups.fill: A river passes through a broad valley. The ri{ver} flows past a to{wn} before turning toward the co{ast}, where the river reaches the sea. A bri{dge} crosses the water near a sta{tion}. From the station a ro{ad} leads to a po{rt} where boats load cargo. A rai{lway} follows the valley through a tun{nel} below a rocky ri{dge}. These routes serve different places, so a map shows their directions and destinations separately. The river flows naturally; the road and railway are built routes.

groups.text:
A Valley Route

A railway runs through a valley. A tunnel carries it beneath a ridge, and a bridge takes it across a river. The station lies east of the bridge. A road leads from the station to a lake, but the railway continues north to a town.

items.why: a bridge takes it across a river 表明桥横跨河流。
The station lies east of the bridge 指明车站在桥东。

items.stem: What does the tunnel pass beneath?
items.why: a tunnel carries it beneath a ridge 指明隧道穿过山脊下方。
a road leads from the station to a lake 指明终点是湖。
the railway continues north to a town 指明铁路向北延伸。

groups.fill: A railway serves several inland towns. The rai{lway} crosses a bri{dge} over a ri{ver} and continues through a tun{nel} beneath the hi{lls}. It reaches a sta{tion} near a la{ke} whose water supplies the surrounding farms. Trains carry passengers and fre{ight}, meaning goods, along the ro{ute}. Travelers can change to bu{ses} at the station. A map distinguishes this railway from the road because the two routes follow different paths through the hills.

groups.text:
A Route Across the Plain

A town stands on the eastern edge of a broad plain. A river flows south through the plain and passes west of the town. Farther south, the river reaches a lake. The town itself is not on the lake shore.

A railway links the town with a port on the coast. It first travels west across the river on a bridge, then turns south toward the port. A station beside the bridge serves villages on both banks. From this station, a road leads east to the town. The road and the railway therefore both reach the town from the bridge.

The port handles goods brought by train. The railway carries these goods from the town toward the coast. A separate road continues from the port along the coast. It does not cross the plain or follow the river. Maps of the area distinguish these routes by showing the bridge, the station and the port as separate locations. The river is a natural waterway, while the railway and roads are built routes.

中文信息：城镇位于平原东缘，河流从镇西向南流入湖中。铁路经桥梁连接城镇与海港，桥旁的车站有公路通往城镇。

items.stem: Where does the river pass the town?
items.why: passes west of the town 说明河流从镇西经过，即第二项。河流向南流的是方向，不是相对城镇的位置。
A railway links the town with a port 指明两个连接地点。

items.stem: What does the bridge carry across the river?
items.why: travels west across the river on a bridge 指铁路经桥过河。

items.stem: Where does the road from the station lead?
items.why: a road leads east to the town 指明方向和终点。

items.stem: What does a road along the coast follow?
items.why: along the coast 表示沿海岸，与 shore 对应。
